top_choice_rationale: P002 (Ciulli, Crews, Deshaies) honours one coherent achievement: designed small molecules that redirect an E3 ligase so a chosen protein is degraded. The effect is measured directly (degradation kinetics, ligase dependence, ternary-complex cooperativity) and reproduced across many laboratories, and the citation can be worded around the mechanism rather than the unfinished clinical record. Its weaknesses are no approved degrader yet and the excluded Sakamoto and cereblon strand. P001 (Buchwald, Hartwig) is more mature with cleaner attribution but extends a field honoured in 2010, so it is second. P003 and P004 follow because in-cell phase separation is still contested and the protein-folding allocation has priority disputes; both rank above no award.
